ActivityExpiryDeletedOverviewMany: Deleted {0} users when their groups expired in {1}: {2}
ActivityExpiryDeletedOverviewOne: Deleted {2} when their groups expired in {1}
ActivityExpiryDisabledOverviewMany: Disabled {0} users when their groups expired in {1}: {2}
ActivityExpiryDisabledOverviewOne: Disabled {2} when their groups expired in {1}
ActivityPasswordChangeBlockedOverview: Blocked {0} from changing their password because their groups disallow it
ActivityPasswordChangeRejectedOverview: Rejected {0}'s new password because it breaks their groups' rules: {1}
ActivityRulesEnrolledOverviewMany: Enrolled {0} users in group password rules: {1}
ActivityRulesRemovedOverviewMany: Removed {0} users from group password rules: {1}
CleanUpOldSessionsHelp: Logs out members' devices that go too long without checking in. The Clean expired sessions task does this, so its schedule sets when.
ConfirmDeleteGroup: Its members keep their other groups. A member in no other group takes Everyone.
ConfirmRunAccountRules: Users whose groups have expired are disabled or deleted now, and inactive users are disabled. A deleted user cannot come back.
DisableInactiveUsersHelp: Disables members who stop using the server.
DisallowEmptyPasswordsHelp: While off, an empty password always passes, since it means the account has no password.
EmptyRules: No rules yet. Select Add rule to add one.
EnforcePasswordRequirementsHelp: Holds members' passwords to the rules below.
ErrorApplyRules: Could not apply the password rules.
ErrorEveryoneFixed: Everyone always exists and cannot be deleted.
ErrorGroupNameTaken: Another group already has this name.
ErrorGroupNotFound: The group no longer exists. Reload the page.
ErrorLoadGroups: Could not load the groups. Reload the page.
ErrorLoadResets: Could not load the password resets.
ErrorLoadSettings: Could not load the settings. Reload the page.
ErrorPasswordChangesDisabled: Password changes are disabled for your account. Ask your server administrator to change it for you.
ErrorPasswordNeedsCapital: Password must contain at least one capital letter.
ErrorPasswordNeedsNumber: Password must contain at least one number.
ErrorPasswordNeedsSymbol: Password must contain at least one symbol.
ErrorPasswordTooShort: Password must be at least {0} characters long.
ErrorSelectExpiration: Select an expiry date or turn off the expiry.
ErrorUserNotFound: The server has no such user.
ExpirationMethodHelp: Disable can be undone. Delete removes each member and their data for good.
ExpireMembersOnDateHelp: Disables or deletes every member once the date comes.
ExpiryDateHelp: The next Process expired and inactive users task run on or after this date expires members.
HelpAccountRulesMerge: A member in several groups is held to the password rules of any of them. Expiry, inactivity, and session cleanup apply only when every group has them.
HelpApplyPasswordRules: Moves users onto or off password rules by their groups, and drops administrators from every group.
HelpCleanSessionsTask: Logs out stale devices now, by each group's session rules.
HelpEveryoneMembers: Everyone holds every user who is in no other group.
HelpGroups: Groups set what their members may do in every tool. A user in no group takes Everyone.
HelpMembers: Administrators may do everything, so no group holds them.
HelpPermissionMerge: A member in several groups gets every allow any of them gives, and the largest limit.
HelpProcessExpiredTask: Disables or deletes expired users and disables inactive users now.
HelpSettings: Sets how each tool works. Who may use a tool is set on its groups.
HelpTroubleshooting: Holds the checks and repairs of each tool.
InactiveDaysHelp: The next Process expired and inactive users task run disables members with no activity for this long. Members who never signed in are left alone.
InviteGroupsHelp: Sets the groups a member's invites may join.
MaxInvitesHelp: Sets how many open invites a member may have. 0 is no limit.
MaxPeersHelp: Sets how many peers a member may have. 0 is no limit.
MovieQuotaHelp: Sets how many movies a member may request in the window Requests sets. 0 is no limit.
NewUserGroupHelp: Sets the group a new user joins. Everyone leaves them in no group.
PasswordChangesHelp: Sets whether members may set or change their own password. Administrators always can.
ResetsDisabled: Reset codes are off. Turn on Show reset codes in Settings to list them.
SeriesQuotaHelp: Sets how many series a member may request in the window Requests sets. 0 is no limit.
SessionOverlapWarning: More than one rule covers {0}. The shortest window applies where rules overlap.
SessionRulesHelp: Each rule logs out devices on its clients after that many days without checking in. A rule for all clients ignores its client list.
ShowResetCodesHelp: Lists the codes of pending password resets in Troubleshooting. Use HTTPS so they cannot be read in transit.
TaskApplyPasswordRulesDescription: Drops administrators and deleted users from the groups, and moves users onto or off password rules by their groups.
TaskCleanSessionsDescription: Logs out devices that have not checked back into the server within their groups' session cleanup windows.
TaskProcessExpiredDescription: Disables or deletes users whose groups have expired, and disables inactive users.
